title: Erich von Däniken on Templar secrets

tellings.quote:
him about the Templars and he goes there
are secrets that I cannot talk about

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he once asked Erich von Däniken, a writer, about the Templars, a medieval order of Christian knights. According to Michels, von Däniken answered that there are secrets about them he cannot talk about. It is told as a hint that a well-known writer is holding back hidden knowledge.
